page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword "Melif-" at the foot right; a small fragment of the neighbouring page at the far left edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: rum Annalibus, imo etiam ex Sacris Paginis, & ex cunctis angulis Exempla: quasi in summa penuria; cum tamen eorum plena sint fora, & quotidie versentur ante omnium ora manusque. Alii ex eadem RHAPSODORUM familia, citandis Auctoribus, præsertim veteribus (quod illis obsoleti plus inesse credant) gnaviter incumbunt: Et quid Zeno, quid Leucippus dixerit, quid contra Parmenides & Melissus censuerint, quid Pythagoras & Empedocles, quid Democritus & Epicurus statuerint, imo statuere debuerint, multis exponunt: His Auctoribus, velut in Theatrum quoddam & Proscenium accitis, tum verò Versibus & Adagiis Fabula peragitur: Nam Zeno rem acu tetigit: & Leucippus in Sententiam ejus manibus pedibusque concessit: Parmenides & Melif-

page.notes: Running head "QUÆST. QUODLIBFT." set in small capitals; "RHAPSODORUM" set in capitals with small capitals; the page's text is set in roman with italic passages; the word "Melif-" at the foot is a catchword. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably in "Melissus" and "Empedocles".
